newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: PDVSA net profits rose 44 pct in 1996 - Giusti.
newsitem.headline: PDVSA net profits rose 44 pct in 1996 - Giusti.

text.p: Venezuela's state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) made a net profit of $4.48 billion in 1996, up 44 percent from $3.103 billion in 1995, PDVSA President Luis Giusti told Reuters Friday.
"It has been the third successive year of record results," Giusti said during a brief interview in Congress.
The improved profits were due to higher export prices and production levels combined with greater operational efficiency, he said.
Total revenues in 1996 were about $32 billion, up 23 percent from $26.041 billion in 1995, he added.
PDVSA will present its final results for 1996 at an annual general meeting on March 21, Giusti said.
